a4Stacks.label: Adapt With Ease
a4Stacks.reason: It raises the active character's damage, and her Exquisite Throws hit while another character is active.

c4Stacks.label: Constellation 4 party HP
c4Stacks.reason: A Constellation 4 party buff that depends on how many enemies are marked.

party.reason: Her usual teams, Hydro with Pyro and Electro (National) or with Dendro and Electro (Hyperbloom), have three elements; four needs every other member to be of another element as well, which fewer teams do, so the usual team is not the one that gives her the most. A team of Hydro and one other element is in the list for the rest.
